FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

How do I book?

Send an enquiry through the form or on WhatsApp with your passenger count, route, date and timing. We suggest the right vehicle and share a quote. Once you confirm dates and pickup points with our coordinator, your booking is set.

Is an advance payment required?

Our team confirms advance payment terms together with your quote, before you confirm the booking.

Are toll and driver allowance included?

Tolls, parking and driver allowance are shared upfront in your quote, so you know the full cost before you book.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellation terms are shared with your quote. If your plans change, please tell us as early as possible so we can re-plan.

Which vehicle size suits my group?

Ertiga/Dzire cars seat 4–6, Tempo Travellers 12–17, 2x2 buses 30–40, and 2x3 buses and luxury coaches 50–60. Tell us your group size and we will recommend the right one.

Do you offer AC buses and monthly contracts?

Yes. We have AC and non-AC buses, and school, college and corporate transport can run on monthly contracts priced per km. See the Tariff section for details.
